summary: Runs raster jobs in the page's raster worker: the latest request per layer, cancellation into the worker, and recreation after a crash.

faults.when: The worker died; it is recreated and the jobs re-run.

lifetime: Per window, while any raster is demanded; the worker lingers briefly after.

x-friction.gap: Latest request per slot, cancellation into the worker, only complete bundles published, and crash recovery are written by hand.
x-friction.closes: A worker pool with keyed latest-wins queues, cancellation into the worker and a crash policy.
